disqualifier.note: Match.when handles all four combinations including dirty+unpushed; WorktreeResidueReason names clean, dirty, unpushed-commits, and dirty+unpushed so every 2^n combo is a legal independently observed git fact.

evidence.note: validateRemovalRequest refuses deleteBranch without archive; branch deletion is only legal behind archive retirement so deleteBranch implies archive.

notes: Phase literal remove|archive|archive-and-delete-branch; delete-branch-only is illegal.

disqualifier.note: Independent per-kind documentation gates; checkFunction writes both true and class members write enforceExample true with enforceVersion false, so all combinations are legal.
Independent axes (CI-hosted executor vs baseline regeneration); usesShardedCoverageExecutor currently ignores both flags and always returns true, so combined-true is not a masked union.

Independent axes: dryRun skips all writes after the scan, force only changes exist-refusal; a dry-run of a forced replace is a legal combination (exists+force still returns before staging when dryRun).
